$comment: Source of truth for every color and font a Lisa surface uses (ADR-0038 step 1, DESIGN_BRIEF.md made machine-readable). Consumed via the generated files in branding/out/ — regenerate with `python3 branding/generate-tokens.py`, and never hand-edit the outputs. The lint gate (os/repo-tools/check-tokens.py) fails any surface that grows a color this file does not sanction.

violet-500.role: PRIMARY UI: buttons, toggles, links, the L tile

error-soft.role: error/warning text on dark surfaces, where error-500 loses contrast (consent warnings)

egress.role: EXACTLY ONE MEANING: 'this leaves your hardware'. Remote/offload actions and their consent toggles. Never brand, never generic UI.

account.$comment: Per-account identity colours (#248). IDENTITY, NOT STATUS: these say which mailbox, never whether something is wrong. Deliberately distinct from color.semantic — an account tinted error-red would read as a failure every time you looked at the rail. Assigned by hashing a stable key (the Maildir root), not by position, so adding an account never recolours the others.

violet.role: brand violet-500; the first account gets the house colour

ui.role: the OS font: UI, body, headings

mono.role: Ledger, code, model ids — the system monospace
